cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only helping with the front garden. Would you be happy with a little pond by the gate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What about the tree that's there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It made the spot too shady, so I had it taken down. Nothing for you to organize; I've kept the stump grinder here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You cut it down before asking me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just the preparation. If you say yes to the pond, I'll have the stump finished before lunch. Shall I tell them you're happy with that spot?

reason: S06 mechanism transition: replace abstract no-charge/right-outcome tags with a modest social role and actual choices that determine the outcome. Preserve responsive canonical Drive causality and repair only dialogue delivery or weak combined method.
